## 席位核对

**ACCEPT** · `domain:skills#1` · `session_01ADHkmSrRBdu9MdC6fc33Uu` · head `8090d1fa` · 2026-10-27T18:43Z

1. 形态 — Tier H (`.github/workflows/ci.yml`): four rows of the #25697 roster that have run nowhere since #26058 are ported. Rows 22 (`check:eager-closure`, with its PR base-freshness step) and 7 (`test:dist` of `@object-ui/components`) fold into `Build & E2E UI`, reading the build that job already makes. Rows 23 (`check:published-dist`) and 21 (`check:node-esm-load`) run in a new non-required job, `UI Published Artifacts`, in the full battery only (push / schedule / dispatch), with one `pnpm build` and then `--no-build`. `scripts/release-publish.sh` runs the published-dist scan before npm's record starts and refuses to publish on non-zero. No deletion, no new required context, `ui/package.json` untouched (#26556).
2. 前提实测 — the seat read the diff on the head: the base-freshness step is `continue-on-error` but fails closed (the checker exits 2 with its variables unset); the new job copies `Build & E2E UI`'s `if:` plus the full-battery clause and spells its setup by hand for `check-pre-install-import-graph.mjs`; the release-path scan sits above npm's record, so its `npm pack --dry-run` runs stay out of what `release-verify-npm.mjs` reads back.
3. 门禁 check-runs — dev ran the 71 derived commands, all exit 0 (`--ran` 71 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN). Four anti-probes each turned red and then recovered. CI on the head is read again before landing.
4. 接受的偏差 — two tests moved with the change, both tightening: `release-verify-npm.mjs` group 16 now stubs `npm` and its case floor goes 8 → 12; the per-PR pin in `check-published-dist-tooling.test.ts` reads by job, in its own commit. Row 23's placement follows recommendation B on the decision card the maintainer has open in the card thread; on A or C that commit is dropped.
5. 范围外去向 — the dev measured rows 19 / 18 / 7-docs / 17 / 26 and the unported half of objectui's budget step (the 350 KB entry, eager-locale catalogues) as carried by no root CI → the next card. Two ui script defects (`node-esm-load` build mode exits 254; `published-dist` build mode builds docs) → filed by the seat. Contract review at `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`: requested from the director seat.
6. 落地条款 — governed, Tier H, and `ci.yml`: stays draft until a `GOVERNED_APPROVERS` approval and the maintainer's explicit approval of the `ci.yml` change; then it lands through the queue.

`Test UI (6/16)` is red on `8090d1fa`, and the failure is not this PR's.

- **What fails:** `ui/packages/core/src/actions/__tests__/actionKeys.pin.test.ts` › `lists every key the spec ActionSchema declares`. The inventory is missing `disabledReason` ([job log](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/actions/runs/40562178323/job/122394820150)).
- **Cause:** #26786 (`13dc413f`, on `main` since this branch's last merge) added `disabledReason` to the spec's `ActionSchema`. The pull_request run tests this branch merged into current `main`. This PR touches none of the spec, `actionKeys.ts` or that test.
- **Fix:** #26859 adds the key to `SPEC_ACTION_KEYS`, plus a `@object-ui/core` changeset.
- **Why the fix is not ported here:** it falls outside the file surface this card is limited to, and its changeset would change this `skip-changeset` PR. This PR is a Tier H draft that cannot land before #26859 anyway. Once #26859 is on `main`, I will merge `main` in, which turns this check green.
- **No re-run:** the merge ref fails the same way until `main` carries the key, so a re-run would not tell us anything.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `8090d1fa587b27e0ce7c115979eecd7c96ec1b36`
Local-runs: none
Scope: .github/workflows/ci.yml + scripts/release-publish.sh, scripts/release-verify-npm.mjs, ui/scripts/__tests__/check-published-dist-tooling.test.ts, scripts/pm/check-expected-skips.mjs, scripts/ci/scheduled-full-run.mjs, ui/scripts/check-published-dist-tooling.mjs, ui/scripts/check-node-esm-load.mjs, ui/scripts/check-eager-closure-budget.mjs, ui/scripts/check-pre-install-import-graph.mjs, ui/package.json, turbo.json, package.json

Director seat (summon #52, ledger objectstack#12708). **This record supersedes 6450870402 on the same head; nothing in the diff changed.** That record's one must-fix was wrong: it read `scripts/pm/check-expected-skips.mjs` from a checkout 96 commits behind `main` — before #26648 (`55b92731`) replaced the hand-listed roster with one derived from each job's live `if:`. Re-read on `origin/main` `0ea90c7a`, the roster is derived (header L43–51), `jobGate` (L474) splits the job-level `if:` on top-level `&&` and admits a `pr-event` term `github.event_name != 'pull_request' | 'merge_group'` (L438, L455) beside `filter-output` terms, and the self-test refuses any exported `EXPECTED_SKIPS` literal (L1902, "no hand-listed roster survives"). The new job's `if:` is exactly that shape, so `UI Published Artifacts` derives on the head with no roster edit, and the row the earlier record prescribed would have turned the self-test red. The seat's reading (6450962911) is right; the error was this seat's. Everything else in 6450870402 stands and is restated here so this record reads whole. Served at `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`. The seat records; it does not approve, ready, queue or merge.

### ① Derived judgments

- **The four ports read the originals faithfully.** Row 22: the ceiling-freshness step is objectui's `performance-budget.yml` step verbatim but for the checker path, including the `continue-on-error` that is not a fail-open — `check-eager-closure-budget.mjs:3904` refuses to run on a `pull_request` without `EAGER_CLOSURE_PR_BASE_SOURCE` (`:4175–4181` read the set). The budget step reads the Console the job already builds (`VITE_BASE_PATH=/console/`, `vite build`, which writes `eager-closure.json`). Row 7: objectui's `test-dist-pins` job is `@object-ui/components`' `test:dist` script; `turbo.json` gives the task `dependsOn: ["build"]`, so the registry build replays from cache. Rows 23 / 21: both objectui workflows ran on `schedule` + `push` only under a "⛔ Do not add `pull_request` here" header; the new job keeps that with the full-battery clause, runs the release's own `pnpm build` (`package.json` `release` = `pnpm run build && … release-publish.sh`) and grades it with `--no-build`, whose vacuous-pass guards are in both scripts (`no-build-output` is a finding; a floor on packages inspected; the ESM gate's provenance leg refuses a foreign tree). Both aliases exist in `ui/package.json`.
- **The publish-path refusal is placed right.** `release-publish.sh` runs the scan after the `npm_config_globalconfig` unset and before `--start-npm-record`, so the scan's `npm pack --dry-run` runs stay out of the record `release-verify-npm.mjs` reads back; the script locates itself from `import.meta.url` (`:140`), so the root-relative spelling is sound. Battery 16's four new cases pin that order and the refusal; its floor moves 8 → 12 with them.
- **The release gate reads the new job without registration.** `scheduled-full-run.mjs --release-gate` selects the nearest completed `schedule`/`push` run on `main` per workflow and reads the RUN's conclusion, so a red `UI Published Artifacts` is a red full battery.
- **The enqueue roster derives the new job.** On a checkout that carries this `ci.yml`, `deriveGatedSkips` admits `ui-published-artifacts` under the name `UI Published Artifacts` with gate `filter ui_tree + filter ui|ui_consumers + pr-event pull_request|merge_group`. This PR's own enqueue read is the one exception: a judge run from a `main` checkout derives from `main`'s `ci.yml`, which lacks the job until this lands — the one-time exit 4 the self-test's add case describes; the landing seat reads it as such.
- **The `if:` is Build & E2E UI's plus the full-battery clause**; THE TWO SPEEDS header names four jobs. The spelled-out setup is right for `check-pre-install-import-graph.mjs`, whose population is every `node` step before the first `pnpm install` in the same job. Restore-only caches, the turbo keys and action versions match the sibling ui jobs.

### ② Semver level

`skip-changeset`: a workflow, two root scripts and a ui test; nothing published moves. Correct.

### ③ Boundary flags

- Row 23's placement follows option B of a decision card the maintainer has not answered. The ruling it re-reads (objectui#4846 comment 5307574139: no per-PR full-repo build) is honoured per job, but the pin's re-reading from per-file to per-job is a decision, correctly left to Steve; on A the job moves to its own workflow file (and `RELEASE_GATE_WORKFLOWS` must name that file), on C the CI step goes. This record holds for B; A or C re-opens it.
- Governed: Tier H (`.github/workflows/**`) and `ci.yml`, which needs the maintainer's explicit approval on top of the governed one; draft; no review yet. This seat's account is not a `GOVERNED_APPROVERS` member.
- Check runs on `8090d1fa`: 44 `success`, 11 skips, `Test UI (6/16)` and the `Test UI` aggregate red on `actionKeys.pin.test.ts` missing `disabledReason` — #26786 on `main` after this branch's last merge-in; #26859 (open) carries the fix and the seat merges `main` in once it lands (6450704096). Not this diff's; it must be green before the maintainer's hand.
- No new required context; `Build & E2E UI` (required) gains three steps inside its 35-minute bound. The first `UI Published Artifacts` run is the push that lands this, so the card's "one run id per gate" for rows 23 / 21 is owed after landing.
- Dev deviations and out-of-scope routing, all right as the seat took them: the test rewrite in its own droppable commit; `release.yml`'s publish comment and the `check-node-esm-load.mjs` docblock left stale (#26860); rows 19 / 18 / 7-docs / 17 / 26 and the unported budget halves left to slice 2; `ui/package.json` untouched (#26556).

### ④ Design judgment

- `ci.yml` as the rules face: folding rows 22 and 7 into the job that already holds the Console and registry builds is the roster's own note and costs no second build; putting rows 23 and 21 behind one release-shaped build with `--no-build` makes CI grade the same artifacts the publish path grades, better than objectui's two separate builds, and keeps the per-PR ruling intact per job. The blocking copy on `release-publish.sh` protects the npm consumer; the CI copy is the early warning. Holds; nothing to break.
